Book a Meeting

A job you’ll thrive in, a career you’ll love

We’re more than a technology company. We’re rethinking delivery logistics, helping operators deliver fast, efficiently, and at massive scale. We’re bursting with energy and breaking down barriers. We’re passionate about innovation, about our customers, about our people.

Does this strike a chord? If yes, then we’re looking for you!

Explore Current Openings →

Who We Are

Consumer behavior and purchasing norms are shifting, fast moving from a store-centric model to a delivery based economy. Applicat, with our industry-leading delivery logistics platform, is both enabling and fueling this transition.

At the core is our home-grown Right-First-Time AI, that helps our clients deliver accurately, never missing a first attempt and providing unbeatable customer experiences.

We invite you to join us in furthering our technology, our messaging, our reach, to help bring the best possible logistics solutions to delivery operators the world over.

A Transpairing
work environment

Unrestricted access to information and knowledge, independence and teamwork, the latest tools, doors that are always open. Inspiring your best work, your best self.

Growing
Together

Few would argue that personal and professional growth beget business growth. We embrace this, seeding and cultivating career growth opportunities throughout the company.

Be a last mile
Innovator

Ceaseless technological innovation is how we stay ahead of the delivery economy’s explosive growth. So be ready to do things you’ve never done before.

An aspiring culture

With remarkable people like you, we’re building a culture of continual improvement. A culture of teams that motivate individuals to peak performance. A culture of responsibility and accountability, of cooperation and recognition. A culture where people thrive, technology blossoms, and the company flourishes.
